pre_scoring_gate: Run the frozen v3 36-task planner reliability regression first. Both Generic Planner and Method Planner must have zero planner errors after deterministic normalization and at most one repair; otherwise v4 scoring must not start.
planning_hypothesis: Generic Planner minus Vanilla mean score >= +2.0 and paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.
method_increment_hypothesis: Method Planner minus Generic Planner mean score >= +1.5 and paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.
interpretation_policy: If Generic Planner beats Vanilla but Method Planner does not beat Generic Planner, attribute the gain to planning rather than Method Cards.
Do not claim Method-Card task gain unless the method-increment comparison and all reliability/actionability guardrails pass.
If Generic Planner does not beat Vanilla, keep Vanilla as the default runtime.
The 36 v3 tasks are development/regression data only and cannot support new v4 task-gain claims.
Do not modify v4 tasks, rubric, success rules, Runtime Cards, Planner Contract, reliability policy, Router prompt, or Skill definitions after inspecting scored v4 results.
